selection_rule: Candidate must improve mean CV WAPE by >=0.5 pp and >=5% relatively, win >=3/4 folds, and have |bias| <=10%.
protocol_revision: The preliminary 1 pp threshold inherited from the prior 88% WAPE problem was replaced before opening any candidate-model holdout predictions. At an 11% baseline WAPE, 1 pp would require an inconsistent 9% relative gain; the frozen rule requires both 0.5 pp absolute and 5% relative skill.
